snapshot: Local merge of the BlindPay feature branch and dev; not a published source commit.
boundary: No Xip bootstrap/auth/routes are registered. Native composition is app/services/ramps + app/providers/ramp_service_provider.go.
adaptations: Separate macro_ramps ORM connection and tenant/environment columns and scope guards.
Native authenticated operator context is preserved; engine contact does not authenticate.
Background recovery and provider bindings are scoped by native account/environment.
Queue staging hands identifiers to the native durable task dispatcher.
Settings validators expose per-account-mode catalogs to the native registry.
Compatibility test helpers do not boot the source application. Darwin closed-port test skips a host-level SYN timeout.
